posts.text: I’m incredibly grateful to share that I’ll be joining Google this summer as an Associate Product Manager (APM) Intern in the Mountain View, California office. A huge thanks to my recruiter Arely Silva for making the process so smooth, and to my mentors and peers whose guidance has been invaluable. If you’re in the Bay this summer, reach out!

My first month working at a YC startup: YC, or Y Combinator, is the world's top startup accelerator, launching giants like Airbnb, Dropbox, and Stripe. What did we do? 1. Built a Lego model of our office (Thanks Panache Ventures) 2. Dressed as wizards, snuck into North America's biggest conference with over 40,000 people (allegedly!) 3. A team cold plunge and sauna session with Othership (highly recommend) Here's what I'm really up to: 1. Building an AI-powered product management platform for PM
